item.title: ZCode
item.description: 여러 AI 에이전트를 한 화면에서 지휘해 코딩 목표를 끝까지 밀고 가는 작업대. ZCode: A coding workspace that runs several AI agents at once and drives a goal to completion. ★ 5.1k · ▲ +44 / 7d · As of 2026-09-21T20:00:00.000Z

item.title: Try Omarchy for Windows

item.title: AgentMeasure

item.title: package-doctor
item.description: 파이썬 의존성 중 실제로 뚫리고 있는 것과 고칠 사람이 없는 것을 가려내는 점검 도구. package-doctor: Scans Python dependencies and tells you which are being exploited now — and which have no one left to fix them. ★ 8 · ▲ 4 HN · As of 2026-09-21T20:00:00.000Z

item.title: Comic Chat for AI

item.title: 2049 — Mines of Merge
